mission.title: Just Another Pretty Face
mission.description: Rescue a comatose hostage from Exiles.

phase.briefing:
Thank you for contacting me. I have an important assignment for you. Before the Truce, an Exile boss grabbed one of our top operatives, Maia, and infected her with a virus. This virus allowed the Exile to use Maia as a personal slave. We need you to rescue Maia and get her back to a hardline.
To make certain the message isn't lost on the Exile kidnappers, we want you to eliminate all of the Exiles that you find there.

enter.say: The Redpill Operative, Maia, is going to need a detox program flushed through her system in order for her to clear the effects of the 'brainwashing' program. Just give her the antidote that I've downloaded to you and she should come to her senses.
